enableSse.description:
Enable Server Sent Events listener for repo watcher.
When this is true, repoWatcher listens to file changes made in server as opposed to local file system.

setup.description: If to run the work dir setup process.

watcher.description: If to run the repository watcher process.

bundler.description: If to run the bundler process.

skipInitialLoader.description: If tos skip applying loaders during repo watcher setup.

port.description: The port on which the UI Development server will listen.

uiNamespace.description: The ui namespace to retrieve configurations for.

minLogLevel.description: Minimum log level. Default is INFO.

workDir.description: Temporary directory where UI code and dependencies will be stored for bundling.

outDir.description: A directory where generated files will be stored.

logDir.description: A directory where logs will be stored.

emitToServer.description: When enabled, all the emited files will be deployed to the environment URL.

configNames.description: When provided, only the listed federated modules will be bundled.

enableBundleAnalyzer.description: If true, enable webpack bundle analyzer plugin.
